preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n + q + 1 lines: the first line with dimensions, n lines for the matrix, and q lines for queries.
The dimensions n, m and number of queries q satisfy the stated bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 1000000 for row in matrix for val in row)
preconditions.description: All elements in the flag matrix are positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= m for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query, the column range [l, r] is valid within the matrix width m.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == count_components(matrix, queries[i][0], queries[i][1]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output line contains the number of connected components in the submatrix defined by rows 1 to n and columns l to r, where connectivity is defined by 4-directional adjacency of cells with identical values.
